# A10 requests (UI)

None of these block A10. Every screen below already renders a plain "isn't in this build yet" state when its route answers 404, and switches to real data as soon as the route exists. The shapes are the TypeScript types in `web/src/api.ts` (section "Forms and recipes", "Inbox (A09) and learning (A09)"); where a module's own report settles on a different shape, I adapt the screen when the lead merges it.

## 1. A05 (form engine): UI routes for Forms and the job timeline

| Method & path | Returns | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/forms/recipes?ats=&status=` | `{ recipes: RecipeRow[] }` (`id, ats, scope, scopeKey, version, status, successes, failures, steps?, createdAt, updatedAt`) | Forms, Recipes tab |
| GET `/api/forms/recipes/:id` | `{ recipe: RecipeRow & { match, steps: RecipeStep[] }, versions: { version, status, successes, failures, updatedAt }[] }` | Recipe drawer, version history |
| POST `/api/forms/recipes/:id/promote` · `/demote` | `{ recipe }` | Manual promote and demote |
| GET `/api/forms/coverage` | `{ ats: { ats, recipes, active, runs, verified, submitted, successRate: number \| null }[] }` | Coverage by ATS |
| GET `/api/forms/runs?jobId=&limit=` | `{ runs: { id, jobId, applicationId, at, status, via, ats, url, verified, reason, shots: string[] /* URLs */, fieldLog: FieldLogEntry[] }[] }` | Job timeline, Form section (step screenshots, field log with value sources, verify result) |

Screenshots should be served by URL (for example `GET /api/forms/shots/:name`, names matched against a strict pattern like `^[0-9a-f-]{36}(-\d+)?\.png$`), never as paths.

Until `/api/forms/runs` exists the timeline falls back to the autopilot journal (`outcome` step detail), `applications.answers` and the final `applications.shot`.

## 2. A06 (browser agent): metrics and traces

| Method & path | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| GET `/api/agent/metrics?days=30` | `{ daily: { day, agentRuns, recipeRuns, adapterRuns }[], costPerRun: number \| null, totals? }` |
| GET `/api/agent/traces?limit=&jobId=` | `{ traces: { id, jobId, applicationId, origin, url, ats, outcome, steps /* count */, createdAt }[] }` |
| GET `/api/agent/traces/:id` | `{ trace: TraceSummary & { steps: TraceStep[] /* beforeShot/afterShot as URLs */, startedAt, finishedAt } }` |

## 3. A09 (inbox and learning)

| Method & path | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| GET `/api/inbox/messages?class=&limit=` | `{ messages: { id, messageId, from, subject, receivedAt, class, confidence?, company, summary, deadline, applicationId, application: { jobId, title, company } \| null, handled, links?, schedulingLinks? }[] }` (never the verification code) |
| POST `/api/inbox/messages/:id/handled` `{ handled }` | `{ ok }` |
| POST `/api/inbox/poll` | `{ fetched }` |
| GET / PUT `/api/inbox/settings` | `{ imap: { host, port, secure, user, passwordSet } \| null, lastPollAt?, lastError? }`; PUT takes `{ host, port, secure, user, password? }` (password into the vault, `imap_password`) |
| POST `/api/inbox/test` | `{ ok, message? }` |
| GET `/api/learning/plans` | `{ plans: { id, applicationId, company, createdAt, plan: LearningPlan }[] }` |
| GET `/api/learning/gaps` · POST `/api/learning/gaps/run` | `{ report: GapReport \| null }` |
| GET / PUT `/api/learning/settings` | `{ autoAcceptTopGaps: boolean }` |

The shell badge already counts `inbox_messages.handled = 0`, and the job timeline reads `inbox_messages` and `outcomes` directly for the Outcome section, so A09 only needs to fill those tables as the contract says. The onboarding "mailbox" step reads `secretHint('imap_password')`; tell me if the secret name differs.

## 4. A11 (ui-smoke runner): expose the data dir

The questions smoke step has to plant one unknown question. The runner doesn't tell steps where the server's data lives, so `scripts/a10/smoke-lib.ts` finds the newest `bureau-ui-*/data` under the OS temp dir (it works, but it's a guess). Please add `dataDir: string` to `UiSmoke` (the step already prefers `t.dataDir` when present) or set `BUREAU_UI_DATA_DIR` in the runner's own environment.

## 5. A02 (matcher), optional

`.seal.F` doesn't exist; the UI shows grade F with the D seal and the number. If the lead wants a distinct F seal, say so and I'll add it to the design record first.
